limitations: No OCR, models or PDF ingest were run or changed. Existing cached scale-bearing text is read; absent evidence stays unknown.
Three archival raster scans have no usable extracted scale evidence. This validates honest unknown handling, not scale accuracy.
Door-icon spread does not bound real door-width uncertainty.
Legacy IFC projection scales rounded to six decimals may not exactly match 1/ppm; both values and differences are exposed without silently changing the measured quantities.
New IFC ingestion captures the native unit assignment. Existing elements.json without it must be regenerated to expose native-unit provenance at runtime.
Printed dimensions require an explicit dimension-line association; no nearest-text guess is made. Scale-bar endpoints are inferred label centres and explicitly labelled as such.
Real IFC files covered IFC2X3 and IFC4; IFC4X3 is covered by generated unit fixtures only.
